{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Hutt Hotel''' was an [[Hotel/Legends|establishment]]. It was a few blocks east of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. At one time, several [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], who was tracking the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], operated out of the building.
